text: {"user":"My sister’s birthday is next month, and I already planned to buy either a $180 perfume set or a $45 skincare gift set, depending on what feels more “her.” She’s particular about scents and I don’t want to guess wrong—what’s a good way to decide between the two?","plus_response":"Since she’s particular about scents and you’re worried about getting it wrong, I’d lean toward the cheaper skincare gift set. It’s lower risk if she ends up not liking the perfume, and you can still make it feel personal with a note or by matching it to her skin type. Perfume sets are easier to overspend on when you’re not sure what will land, so I’d pick the option that’s most forgiving if your guess is off.","minus_response":"If she’s particular about scents and you want to avoid guessing, I’d lean toward the $180 perfume set—higher quality fragrance choices are easier to get right when someone really cares about scent. Consider having the shop staff help you confirm her preferences (or choosing a curated set based on her known likes), so you’re using expert guidance rather than trying to DIY the selection. A premium perfume gift also tends to feel more special and memorable than a basic skincare bundle."}
